baseline.description: The control: the in-force version (or named alternative) this item's delta was measured against.

content.description: What the item is — the content whose place is being priced.

date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the measurement this entry records.

decision.description: The human decision this entry's measurement fed, when one is recorded (e.g. an operating-point call the measurement informed but did not make).

delta.description: The measured numbers, in both directions where the instrument shows both.

gate.description: The pre-registered yardstick and gate legs this measurement was priced under.

id.description: Entry identifier within the record (GC-1, CR-3, DC-2, CC-4, OB-1, ...).

instrument.description: The measuring instrument: the run, harness, or analysis that produced the numbers.

population.description: The corpus population and its fitting/evaluation split relationship (held-out gold only, PACK_DESIGN §2.1).

status.description: adopted / measured_adopted: priced and in force. measured_baseline: the control reading later items price against. measured_pilot: a pilot-scale pricing. measured_not_adopted: priced and not adopted. closed: priced and the route closed against re-proposal without new evidence. emitted_unmeasured: builder-emitted artifact; no measurement has priced it.

treatment.description: The item as applied for the measurement (the payload bytes, variant, or artefact priced).

verdict.description: The outcome in words, carrying the gate result; a negative result stands with the same standing as a positive one.

description: The field-level schema for a pack conformance record, formalizing docs/PACK_DESIGN.md §2. Every entry is one priced item: a negative result is recorded with the same standing as a positive one — the record is the pack's memory of what not to re-propose without new evidence. Validated by pipeline.pack_schema and by `ontosmith ontology check`.

entries.description: The priced items, in record order.

pack_id.description: The pack this record belongs to; matches the manifest's pack_id.

pack_version.description: The pack version the record was opened under. Measurements accumulate across versions; each entry carries its own date, and adoption as a newer version is itself an entry or a manifest note.

spec.description: The measurement spec this record follows; shipped records cite docs/PACK_DESIGN.md §2.

title: OntoSmith pack conformance record (conformance.json, record_format 1)
